_meta.description: German golden questions for the RAG test corpus (#79). Retrieval smoke checks: at least one expected source should appear in the @rag-search sources; for answerable=false the answer must decline. Paths are portal-relative.
_meta.user: Questions are asked as a regular authenticated user unless notes say otherwise.

questions.question: Wie viele Tage vorher muss ich eine Dienstreise beantragen?
questions.notes: Expected answer mentions 5 Werktage and the SAP Travel Management portal.
